_comment: Reference tier profiles (ADR-0015). REASONABLE STARTING POINTS, NOT
BENCHMARKED RECOMMENDATIONS — the evaluation set that would justify a
ranking cannot exist before CHAT-5 and TASK-3, and inventing one would
look measured while being guesswork. Issue #152 tracks replacing these
A tier is a capability-and-cost contract, not a model. Prompts are written
against what a tier guarantees, so re-pointing one at a different model
must not require re-tuning a prompt. Every tier needs at least one entry;
extra entries are fallbacks, tried in order, and every fallback is
recorded in the run trace so a silent downgrade is impossible to miss.
Set this as CHORUS_MODEL_TIERS, and point CHORUS_MODEL_BASE_URL at any
OpenAI-compatible endpoint — including a local one, which is what makes
NFR-1's 'no mandatory SaaS dependency' true rather than aspirational.
Model names live here and never in source: that is what keeps the
boundary rule meaningful and makes a provider's deprecation an ops change
